description: FULL BODY: A Malaysian man in his late 30s with short, neat black hair, wearing a crisp dark navy blue Malaysian police uniform with silver buttons and insignia on the shoulders. He stands tall and authoritative, wearing black tactical boots and formal trousers.

FULL BODY: An elderly Malaysian man in his early 60s with salt-and-pepper hair. He wears a casual short-sleeved checkered shirt tucked into beige chino trousers and brown leather loafers. He has a concerned expression while holding a smartphone.

FULL BODY: A featureless human-shaped silhouette appearing as a digital shadow. The figure is draped in a translucent glitching digital pattern with glowing green binary code flowing across the surface. It wears a stylized, high-collared digital cloak.

FULL BODY: An anonymous, featureless android-like figure with a smooth metallic silver finish. The head is a blank slate without eyes or mouth, and the body has glowing blue data-circuit lines running down the limbs, representing an AI-generated persona.
